purpose: Contemporary primary-source trend checks for Kinova benchmark diagnostics; neither target ranks nor target success rates.
scope: Read-only literature, author-source and dataset inspection. No new planner integration, GPU execution, or local performance claim.

papers.title: Motions in Microseconds via Vectorized Sampling-Based Planning
papers.venue_correction: RSS 2024 refers to CAPT, a separate collision-checking component paper, not the original VAMP planning paper.

protocol.dataset: Public MotionBenchMaker: Panda 7-DoF and Fetch 8-DoF, seven environments with 100 problems each; Baxter 14-DoF bimanual bookshelf datasets.
protocol.hardware: AMD Ryzen 9 7950X, 4.5 GHz, AVX2; single-core SIMD planning.
protocol.sampling: Shared multidimensional Halton sequences; matching parameters and collision-check resolution. MoveIt nearest neighbors use L1 rather than L2.
protocol.measurement: Geometric planning and simplification timed separately; not minimum-time execution.
protocol.model: Conservative robot sphere decompositions; code-generated kinematics/collision routines.

papers.interpretation: Strong RRTConnect feasibility is plausible. Collision backend and language boundary can dominate latency without changing the planner family.

papers.title: pRRTC: GPU-Parallel RRT-Connect for Fast, Consistent, and Low-Cost Motion Planning
papers.venue: ICRA 2026, as identified by the author repository
papers.version_caution: Do not combine v1 speedup claims or tables with v2 results.

protocol.dataset: MotionBenchMaker: Panda/Fetch seven environments x 100 problems; Baxter three x 500.
protocol.comparison: OMPL-RRTC uses VAMP motion validation; matched extension range/collision resolution; planner-specific settings tuned.
protocol.sampling: Shared Halton sequences for pRRTC/VAMP/OMPL; other planners use default samplers.
protocol.measurement: Environment setup excluded; initial geometric arclength and planning latency, not constrained execution duration.
protocol.model: Offline hierarchical robot sphere construction; static primitive obstacles.
protocol.unknowns: No common wall timeout or trial repeat count identified in the paper.

papers.interpretation: CPU VAMP is faster than GPU pRRTC on Panda; the ordering reverses on Fetch/Baxter. GPU placement alone predicts neither latency nor reliability.

facts: Reads fixed joint start and the first joint goal constraint, then stores a singleton goals list.
Valid flag requires a collision-valid start and at least one collision-valid goal under VAMP. It is not a planning-success flag.
vamp_mbm_conversion.limits: This endpoint filter does not describe the original MBM generation feasibility filter; the two stages must remain distinct.

prrtc_panda_dataset.conclusion: The inspected Panda dataset has fixed singleton joint goals. The vector-valued API is not evidence of a multi-IK-goal advantage.

facts: Skips valid=false records and constructs host environment before calling solve.
One solve call per valid record; no repeat loop in this entry point.
Settings override num_new_configs=512, granularity=16, range=0.5, balance=2, tree_ratio=1.0 and enable dynamic_domain.
prrtc_runner.limits: Current code settings and denominators are not asserted to be the precise configuration used for every paper table.

facts: kernel_ns surrounds planner kernel plus cudaDeviceSynchronize.
wall_ns includes allocations, initialization, device-environment setup, solving, extraction and cleanup.
Host scene conversion occurs outside solve; cudaDeviceReset occurs after wall_ns is saved.
prrtc_timing.limits: The paper does not unambiguously map Table I to one of the public code timer fields. Do not relabel its reported planning time as cold end-to-end latency.

facts: Reference settings enable dynamic-domain sampling, unlike the original paper; original ranges include Panda=1.25 and Fetch=1.0.
Panda original-MBM gripper separation is 6.5 cm versus 2.5 cm in Robometrics, affecting input validity.
Reference Panda count is 699 solved / 699 valid / 700 registered.
Baxter resource description says 600 per scene, while pRRTC v2 describes 500; these are not silently equated.
vamp_resource_notes.limits: These are author documentation reference timings, distinct from original VAMP Table I.

diagnostic_actions_for_existing_kinova.check: For paired legal queries, inspect validated frontend availability and conditional backend outcomes separately. A robust optimizer cannot fix a frontend failure it never receives.
diagnostic_actions_for_existing_kinova.not_a_target: Do not force Kinova to match MBM success percentages.

diagnostic_actions_for_existing_kinova.check: Break down collision-query count, per-query CPU/GPU synchronization and Python callback overhead, search time, setup and final validation. Compare matched timers before changing algorithm settings.
diagnostic_actions_for_existing_kinova.not_a_target: Do not require sub-millisecond cold runs from generic callbacks because code-generated VAMP achieves sub-millisecond hot planning.

diagnostic_actions_for_existing_kinova.check: Keep registered, invalid-input and legal-query counts separate. Confirm fixed joint targets; never infer easier multi-goal tasks from a vector API alone.
diagnostic_actions_for_existing_kinova.not_a_target: Do not remove legal unknown-feasibility Kinova queries to match a feasibility-filtered dataset.

diagnostic_actions_for_existing_kinova.check: Retain the canonical Kinova and conservative 0.04 m sphere union; compare checker consistency, not only URDF names. Gripper state, environment conversion and sphere coverage can change solvability.
diagnostic_actions_for_existing_kinova.not_a_target: Do not reduce radii or disable collision pairs for better literature agreement.

diagnostic_actions_for_existing_kinova.check: Record actual internal search cap, outer cold-query budget and repeated-seed policy; distinguish iteration limits from wall-time limits.
diagnostic_actions_for_existing_kinova.not_a_target: A 10-second local OMPL search and a 300-second paper allowance do not share an identical protocol.

diagnostic_actions_for_existing_kinova.check: Separate raw initial path, simplified path, optimized geometric output and constrained execution duration; use common-success paired costs and scene-aware uncertainty.
diagnostic_actions_for_existing_kinova.not_a_target: GPU and CPU rankings may reverse across robot, obstacle structure and degree of freedom.

guardrails: Do not change frozen endpoints, collision protocol or validation tolerances.
Preserve failure evidence and distinguish numerical feasibility from continuous certification.
No pRRTC/VAMP local runtime or reproduction claim is made by this evidence file.
